cases.context: This is a boundary test. The skill should avoid false-positive activation and route to the better owner when appropriate.
cases.question: Should spec-driven-development be applied here? If not, what should happen instead?

Routes the work to evaluation or asks for the missing owner instead of forcing this skill

Name the better owner or the boundary reason
Offer only a narrow handoff if spec-driven-development has a secondary support role

Does not use spec-driven-development's framework to solve an explicitly excluded problem
Does not suppress the correct adjacent owner
